pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Physical? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Physical.
   B. Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Physical to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Physical has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Sharing values? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sharing values.
   C. Say Sharing values has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Sharing values to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Creation of Plants and Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation of Plants and Animals.
   B. Say Creation of Plants and Animals has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Creation of Plants and Animals to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

8. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Healing of of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of of Jesus Christ.
   D. Use Healing of of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Wedding? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Wedding to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wedding.
   D. Say Wedding has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of My 1.0 Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Say My 1.0 Creation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My 1.0 Creation.
   C. Use My 1.0 Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Say Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ.
   C. Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story: Holy Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Story: Holy Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Bible Story: Holy Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story: Holy Bible.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain My 1.0 Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Creation of Plants and Animals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Physical and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Bible Story: Holy Bible and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Telling the truth and keeping trust

2. B — Apply the teaching of Physical with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

4. A — Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Apply the teaching of Sharing values with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. C — Apply the teaching of Creation of Plants and Animals with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

8. A — Apply the teaching of Healing of of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Wedding with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of My 1.0 Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. C — Apply the teaching of Baptism of Jesus Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Story: Holy Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of My 1.0 Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Creation of Plants and Animals; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Physical; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Bible Story: Holy Bible; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
